summary: HTTP MCP requires authentication plus TLS for non-loopback listeners, and default sync must exercise valid API resources so structural and mock dogfood cover a real data path.
reason: The MCP surface carries operator authority and cannot expose anonymous or replayable plaintext credentials; the original empty sync plan also made acceptance evidence skip the primary data path despite valid filtered movie endpoints being available.
validated_outcome: Authorization and transport tests reject anonymous callers and plaintext remote binds; structural dogfood and spec-derived mock verification exercise the non-empty default movie sync path.
